Keywords: Bog ore charcoal furnaces and slag forging
RagShortTexts: Iron-bearing wetland deposits can supply ore.
A furnace bloom still needs forging to remove slag.

Variants.Content: Usable wetland ore is gathered and prepared, smelted with charcoal and forged to remove slag. Ore, fuel and skill govern returns. Iron-bearing mud is not finished armor; timber, food and carriage sustain production.
Nails, blades and armor repairs need workable iron and smiths. Mining orders without charcoal or food deliver raw material rather than usable equipment.
Production requires ore, woodland and smiths together. Excess timber claims hurt heating; inspecting usable output matters more than counting miners.
Mining and charcoal work remove farm labor; smithing needs food and tools. Prices ignoring forging losses can leave busy workers unable to support households.
